name: Dead Reckoning
source:
You're Jackston, a university student, four months out from defending your thesis.

A package turns up one day, from a friend you haven't spoken to in six years.

You spent your whole childhood being measured against him, and you're afraid of who you turn into when he's in the room.

Are you ready to confront your past?

[From [url=https://akibread.itch.io/dead-reckoning]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是大学生杰克斯顿，距离毕业论文答辩还有四个月。

某一天，你收到了一个包裹，寄件人是你已整整六年未曾联系过的昔日好友。

整个童年时代，你都在被大人们拿来与他作比较；直到如今，你依然害怕当他出现在同一个房间里时，自己会变成怎样一副模样。

你准备好直面自己的过去了吗？

[摘自[url=https://akibread.itch.io/dead-reckoning]itch.io[/url]]
